title: Out-of-hours Alpaca market brackets are false-closed exchange_flat_reconciled and re-entered every ~7 min (SLV 877 / QQQ 1981 stacked on paper; journal tracks 6 / 2)
note: Root cause and arithmetic on PI-20261118-JFWRQYOV-0004 (HEALTH-REVIEW-20261118). Change: in order_monitor._reconcile_orphan_exchange_positions, a row whose own entry order is still OPEN at the broker is not flat (read alpaca open orders by broker_order_id before arming), and/or stop 1h equity legs from sending market brackets outside RTH. Premortem: a not-flat rule keyed on open orders could strand a row whose entry was cancelled at the venue; resolve on order status filled/cancelled, never on age. Closes when: the next pre-market 1h equity signal yields ONE package and ONE open row that survives the open, INV-JOURNAL-EXCHANGE passes on alpaca_paper/alpaca_portfolio, and the 871 SLV / 1979 QQQ untracked shares are adopted or flattened by record. Gates this adds: none.
